data_fields.name: weapon_blows_min_max
data_fields.donor_constant: per weapon; interpolated by hp (rule as in donor)

best_idea: Compute each hit as one integer percent stack (base x (100 + bonuses) x resistance%) rounded once with ties toward the base damage, alternate strikes with a firststrike opener, and let the server resolve each strike from one seeded roll.
decision_why: Frankendom's duel needs one exact damage formula that the server can recompute; the donor's integer rounding and strike order fit duel step row 1, but its biased credit mode and its replay-override of deaths do not fit one ledger with server-verified kills.
acceptance: A server test asserts that base 10 with +25 percent time-of-day and 100 percent resistance deals 12 (the tie goes toward the base), and that the same seed gives the same hit list and hp on the server and in the client.
